'''Garem Will''' was a [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] player as of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He competed in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies Region]] [[Colonies region Dejarik tournament|dejarik tournament]], where he was defeated by fellow player [[D'nisenz]].
